collection.title: Toyota Previa/Estima 2006 to 2016 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Toyota Previa 2006 - 2016 requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 16" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. There is also the option to upgrade to the newer Retrofit wiper blades.
